answer: Incentives do the work here. Reviewers stake, are spot checked, and lose the stake when they pass junk. Accepted rewards do not arrive at once; they vest over 100 epochs and only against future tasks, so an identity that quits after one payout keeps roughly 3% of it. The unit of trust is the task, not the account. A cipher of clone accounts must keep producing real tasks through the whole spiral of vesting, and a plume of recycled reviews does not count as work.
